user.title: Entity Timer
user.description: Adds services to turn an entity on or off until a chosen date & time, plus a companion 'entity-timer-card' Lovelace card. No configuration needed — press Submit.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Entity Timer is already configured. Only a single instance is needed.

set.name: Set timer
set.description: Turn an entity on or off immediately and schedule reverting it back at a given date & time.

until.name: Until
until.description: When to revert the entity to its previous state.

cancel.name: Cancel timer
cancel.description: Cancel a pending timer for an entity, immediately reverting it to its normal state instead of waiting for the scheduled time.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The entity whose pending timer should be cancelled.
